example: I wake up at six thirty.
I take a shower every night.
tip_zh: 「洗澡」日常多說 take a shower

example: I brush my teeth after breakfast.
tip_zh: teeth 結尾是咬舌 th，不是 s

example: She gets dressed very quickly.
tip_zh: dressed 的 -ed 唸 /t/，不要加「的」音

example: We have breakfast at a breakfast shop.
tip_zh: break 在這裡唸 brek，不唸 brake

example: My commute is about an hour.
My mom takes a nap after lunch.
example_zh: 我媽媽午餐後會睡午覺。
tip_zh: nap 尾音 p 嘴唇閉上就好，不加「ㄜ」

example: My son does the dishes after dinner.
I do the laundry on Sundays.
tip_zh: l 和 r 都要唸清楚：LAWN-dree

example: I always drink coffee in the morning.
tip_zh: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前：I always…

example: I usually take the MRT to work.
tip_zh: 中間是 /ʒ/ 音，像輕輕的「日」

example: Sometimes I cook dinner at home.

english: What time do you get up?
example: What time do you get up on weekdays?
tip_zh: do you 常弱化成 duh-yuh

example: I'm a morning person, so I get up early.
example_zh: 我是早起型的人，所以很早起床。

example: I'm a night owl, so mornings are hard.
example_zh: 我是夜貓子，所以早上很難熬。
tip_zh: 英文的「夜貓子」是貓頭鷹 owl

english: How do you get to work?
example: How do you get to work every day?
By scooter, it takes about thirty minutes.
example_zh: 騎機車大概要三十分鐘。
tip_zh: thirty 的 th 要咬舌，不是 s

example: On weekdays, I get home around six.

english: I go to bed around eleven.
example: I go to bed around eleven every night.
example_zh: 我每天晚上大概十一點睡覺。

example: What's your daily routine on weekends?
